title: Daddy Chill
blurb: Wooden delivery, total commitment, and absolutely no interest in acting — the exact combination that turns an amateur web series clip into permanent internet scripture. The line arrives with such flatness that it stopped being bad and became transcendent, which is a rare category of accidental art. It has been quoted, remixed and animated more times than anything in the series it came from. Play it when somebody needs to calm down immediately and for reasons nobody present can articulate. What the hell is even that.
origin: From the viral 'What the hell is even that?' web-series clip.
